decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting serves a specialised maritime defence niche with long program lifecycles and low holding cost, so the option stays open while naval demand matures.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires are a certified core segment, and the 2019 LED replacement kit shows management is investing further rather than abandoning the option.
The relaunched designer task light builds on an established popular model and costs little to keep, although design products face faster turnover and it is now several years old.
The pendant office luminaire fits the core office lighting business and still holds upside as LED office retrofits continue, while keeping it in the range costs little.
The premium pendant luminaire remains a cheap option within a broad portfolio, though premium office demand after the pandemic is uncertain and it could be replaced by a successor model.
